id: title:haacked:skip malformed trigger groups when building remote config

review.posthog_relevance: Adds typed error handling and defensive parsing for session recording trigger groups, supporting the backend-to-frontend configuration contract.
review.reason: Adds a new exception class, changes return type, and adds defensive checks. No tier 3 systemic risk or tier 1 narrow-only. Tier 2.
review.uncertainty: Chunk does not include the caller or downstream consumer, so the complete execution path and actual runtime behavior are not demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the caller that invokes the return value of `_build_session_recording_config` or the downstream consumer of the returned `False` or the exception. The chunk also does not show the complete execution path of the exception handling or the complete implementation of the V2 configuration building. Therefore, while the changes are clear,

observations.behavior: Adds a new exception class `UnreadableTriggerGroupsError` to document a failure mode where stored session recording trigger groups cannot be parsed by the JavaScript SDK.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a typed error for telemetry and debugging when the backend stores trigger group configurations that the frontend cannot interpret, supporting the session recording feature.

observations.behavior: Changes the return type of `_build_session_recording_config` to include `bool` and documents that it returns `False` when trigger groups are unreadable.
observations.code_quote: Returns False when team.session_recording_trigger_groups is set but holds no readable group.
observations.posthog_connection: Establishes the contract for the session recording configuration builder, allowing downstream callers to distinguish between a successful V2 config and a failure state.

observations.behavior: Adds defensive checks and normalization for the `trigger_groups_config` and its nested `groups` and `events` fields, including type checks and skipping malformed entries.
observations.posthog_connection: Implements the parsing and normalization of session recording trigger groups, including skipping groups with invalid structure and reporting dropped groups via an exception. This protects the session recording feature from malformed backend data.
